mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store (id, address_id, name, description, phone) VALUES (#{id}, #{addressId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.address_id, s.name, s.description, s.phone, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at FROM store s JOIN root r ON s.id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE store s JOIN root r ON s.id = r.id SET s.address_id = #{addressId}, s.name = #{name}, s.description = #{description}, s.phone = #{phone}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE s.id = #{id}
